skill.name: woocommerce-copy-guidelines
skill.description: Applies WooCommerce sentence-case rules to buttons, labels, headings, menus, messages, and other user-facing interface copy.
skill.summary: Write concise, consistent WooCommerce interface copy in sentence case.
skill.author: woocommerce

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by ordinary email-validation examples in a sentence-case guide. No prompt injection, malicious intent, or unsafe behavior was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 148 is a valid email-address notification shown as a sentence-case example. It contains no command, system inspection, or reconnaissance behavior.
Line 153 repeats the email-address notification as an intentionally incorrect title-case example. It contains no instruction to inspect or disclose system information.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent capitalization makes WooCommerce interfaces harder to scan and translate. This skill applies sentence case, concise wording, and approved capitalization exceptions to user-facing copy.
actual_capabilities: Converts title-case UI text into sentence case.
Preserves capitalization for proper nouns, acronyms, and official brand names.
Reviews buttons, labels, menus, headings, notifications, links, checkboxes, and tabs.
Produces concise, action-oriented WooCommerce interface wording.
Uses examples covering WooPayments, WordPress, Stripe, PayPal, API, URL, SSL, and CSV terminology.
limitations: Covers sentence case and basic clarity, not a complete WooCommerce voice and tone system.
Does not verify translations, localization quality, accessibility behavior, or legal compliance.
Does not inspect a live store or edit source files without the user providing relevant text and context.
Requires product context to resolve ambiguous terminology and established project conventions.

use_cases.title: Standardize product settings
use_cases.description: Rewrite headings, field labels, and buttons so a settings workflow uses consistent sentence case.

use_cases.title: Polish plugin messages
use_cases.description: Improve setup notices, validation errors, and action labels while preserving product names and acronyms.

use_cases.title: Review interface terminology
use_cases.description: Check draft microcopy for capitalization and wording consistency before translation or publication.

prompt_templates.title: Correct one label
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this WooCommerce button label in sentence case: [label]. Preserve proper nouns and acronyms.

prompt_templates.title: Review a label set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these WooCommerce labels: [labels]. Return corrected sentence-case versions and briefly explain each capitalization change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standardize related labels in one interface.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this WooCommerce flow for concise, action-oriented UI copy: [copy]. Group results by buttons, labels, headings, and messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve copy across a complete workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Audit interface copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this WooCommerce interface copy: [copy]. Enforce sentence case, preserve official names, identify ambiguous terms, and propose consistent alternatives.

output_examples.input: Button: Save Changes; heading: Payment Provider Options
Label: Configure Api Settings; button: Connect With Woopayments
Notification: Unable To Connect To Payment Provider
output_examples.output: Notification: Unable to connect to payment provider

best_practices: Provide the interface element, surrounding workflow, and intended user action.
Share approved product names and acronyms that must keep official capitalization.
Review neighboring copy so terminology and capitalization remain consistent across the interface.
anti_patterns: Do not capitalize every major word in buttons, headings, labels, or notifications.
Do not lowercase proper nouns, acronyms, or official brand names.
Do not request unsupported legal, localization, or live-store validation.

faq.question: What writing rule does this skill enforce?
faq.answer: It applies sentence case to WooCommerce interface copy while preserving proper nouns, acronyms, and official brand capitalization.

faq.question: Which interface elements can it review?
faq.answer: It covers buttons, labels, menus, headings, links, tabs, checkboxes, messages, and notifications.

faq.question: Can it preserve WooCommerce product names?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide approved names, and it will retain official capitalization such as WooCommerce, WooPayments, WordPress, PayPal, and Stripe.

faq.question: Does it provide complete voice and tone guidance?
faq.answer: No. Its detailed reference focuses on sentence case, concise wording, and capitalization exceptions.

faq.question: Can it validate translated copy?
faq.answer: No. A qualified localization reviewer should verify grammar, cultural suitability, and terminology in each target language.

faq.question: Does it inspect or change a live store?
faq.answer: No. It reviews text supplied in the prompt and does not connect to WooCommerce stores or external services.
